_source: SYNTHETIC — no live search reproduces this shape today (a live silpo_find_products_batch("віскі") on 2026-09-19 returned 5 whiskeys all in the same 970-2600₴ band, no outlier among them). Hand-built to match the scenario named in pick-product.ts's own comment on the anomaly guard: a plain 'віскі' search where the top hit is an isolated premium bottle costing several times the rest of the returned candidates. Candidate 0 here is priced ~9x the median of the other four (which use real everyday whiskey prices/names as a realistic baseline) — comfortably past the `price > median * 5` threshold in pick-product.ts. Deliberately does NOT name a specific brand in the request (unlike the comment's own 'віскі Ballantine's' example) — naming one brand makes parseItems keep it in `query`, which then makes checkRelevance correctly reject every OTHER brand as a brand mismatch, masking the anomaly guard entirely (confirmed live while building this case). The anomaly guard and the brand-relevance check are both working as designed there — it's just not the right fixture for isolating the anomaly guard specifically.
